_: No exit tax in law; past proposals (AB 2088, AB 259) were never enacted. Residency rules may still result in post-departure taxation of California-source or previously-earned income.
Pennsylvania does not have an official exit tax, but it does have a "deemed sale" provision that can result in a tax liability for some residents who move out of state.
